asciichat_error_t asciichat_mdns_advertise (asciichat_mdns_t * mdns, const asciichat_mdns_service_t * service)

Advertise a service on the local network.

Parameters

mdns mDNS context
service Service to advertise

Returns

ASCIICHAT_OK on success, error code otherwise

Note

Copies service records; caller storage may be released after return. One service is owned per context. Re-advertising replaces it after joining its worker.
